item.title: NHL Trade Rumors: Edmonton Oilers in advanced trade talks on Andrew Mangiapane
item.description: The Edmonton Oilers and Andrew Mangiapane haven't been a match made in heaven, and now a trade is expected before the March 6 trade deadline.While the Olympic freeze has halted any movement throughout the NHL, trade talks are heating up and there's growing speculation the Oilers are advancing in their quest to move Mangiapane. item.description: Nazem Kadri isn't the only valued center on the trade market these days, cooling trade talk a bit latey. But that doesn't mean teams aren't still trying to acquire the gritty, intense, playoff-ready center. item.title: 5 Trade Candidates Listed From Chicago Blackhawks
item.description: The first month+ of the NHL season saw the Chicago Blackhawks get off to an unexpectedly strong start, going 10-5-4 and sitting in a playoff spot. But things came crashing down to earth, and the Hawks' rebuild will have to wait another year to advance to the next level.The team currently sits with a 22-26-9 record, and thoughts of a playoff spot are a distant memory.
